bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
head=8f374cc9854c12b03a39d6048c8b2242ac5f67ca
base=86dd6e2fb96f5632bafc18b358669e900998586a
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"
origin="$(git config --get remote.origin.url)"
case "$origin" in *seigo-gace/create-videobot|*seigo-gace/create-videobot.git) ;; *) echo WRONG_REPOSITORY; exit 21;; esac
printf 'LOCAL_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'LOCAL_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'LOCAL_DIRTY_FILES='; git status --porcelain | wc -l
test "$(docker inspect --format '{{.State.Running}}' "$cid")" = true
printf 'LIVE_IMAGE='; docker inspect --format '{{.Image}}' "$cid"
printf 'RUNNING_POLLERS='; docker ps --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=videobot-poll --format '{{.Names}}' | wc -l
git fetch --no-tags origin "$head"
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$head"
git cat-file -e "$base^{commit}"
echo SOURCE_RUNTIME_COMPARISON_BEGIN
git ls-tree -r --name-only "$head" src sql | while IFS= read -r f; do
  target="$(git show "$head:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"
  if git cat-file -e "$base:$f" 2>/dev/null; then old="$(git show "$base:$f" | sha256sum | cut -d' ' -f1)"; else old=ABSENT; fi
  if live="$(docker exec "$cid" sha256sum "/opt/videobot/$f" 2>/dev/null | cut -d' ' -f1)"; then
    if test "$live" = "$target"; then state=TARGET; elif test "$live" = "$old"; then state=BASE; else state=DIVERGED; fi
  else state=MISSING; fi
  if test "$state" != TARGET || test "$target" != "$old"; then printf '%s %s\n' "$state" "$f"; fi
done
echo SOURCE_RUNTIME_COMPARISON_END
echo PRECHECK_COMPLETE_NO_RESTART_NO_DATABASE_WRITE
